chunks: Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Bazzaz informed me. He said: Abu Ahmad Dawud ibn Sulayman al-Farra' narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Musa al-Rida narrated to me from his father Musa ibn Ja'far. He said: My father Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq narrated to me. He said: My father Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir narrated to me. He said: My father Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin narrated to me. He said: My father al-Husayn ibn Ali narrated to me. He said: My father Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon them) narrated to me. He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:
Faith is declaration with the tongue, recognition with the heart, and action with the limbs.

Hamza ibn Muhammad said: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hatim say: I heard my father say -- and he had narrated this hadith from Abu al-Salt al-Harawi, Abd al-Salam ibn Salih, from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) with an identical chain of transmission -- Abu Hatim said: If this chain of transmission were recited upon an insane person, he would be cured.

key_terms.إقرار: Iqrar -- Declaration, affirmation with the tongue
key_terms.الأركان: Al-Arkan -- The limbs/pillars; bodily members through which faith is manifested
key_terms.الإيمان: Iman -- Faith; in Shia theology, faith encompasses verbal profession, inner conviction, and external deeds
key_terms.معرفة: Ma'rifa -- Recognition, deep knowledge through the heart

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic definition of faith (iman) according to the Prophet Muhammad through the Golden Chain?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) defines faith (iman) as comprising three inseparable components: verbal declaration, heartfelt recognition, and physical action. This hadith is transmitted through the famous 'Golden Chain' (silsilat al-dhahab), passing through every Imam from al-Rida back to Imam Ali, and thence to the Prophet. The renowned hadith scholar Abu Hatim al-Razi remarked that this chain is so blessed that if recited over a mentally afflicted person, it would cure them.
